run_kmeans_benchmark: run a k-means clustering benchmark on a dataset using FAISS with configurable iterations and centroids
run_pca_dimensionality_reduction: run PCA dimensionality reduction on training data using FAISS PCAMatrix before clustering
run_gpu_kmeans: run k-means clustering on GPU by transferring a flat L2 index to all available GPUs
run_quantization_error_evaluation: run quantization error evaluation by searching test vectors against computed centroids using L2 distance
run_clustering_with_seed: run k-means clustering with a fixed random seed for reproducible centroid initialization
